interpretation: One user-selected execution design element; source analysis and concrete strategy, not completed runtime certification. Existing semantics and runtime-sensitive admission must be preserved.

environment.hardware: Keep each evidence series separate: historical Marvin A40/fp32, current self-hosted ASV series, CPU planning replay, IAME V100/fp32 or fp64.
environment.backend: Source lock and executed receipts; JAX/JAXLIB0.11.1 in reported series, do not infer executed precision from a default.
environment.dtype: Both supported fp32/fp64; never compare across precision/hardware as causal evidence.

metric_definitions.warm_seconds: Synchronized completed public solve, supplied simulation, or automatic solve+simulate separately. State retention, diagnostic level, seeds and instrument overhead.
metric_definitions.compile_seconds: Directly instrumented lowering/backend/orchestration boundaries separately; never infer compile by cold-minus-warm.
metric_definitions.peak_device_bytes: Per-selected-device allocator live high-water mark, not reserved pool or nvidia-smi process total. Compiler reservation and BFC ceiling are different quantities.
metric_definitions.numerical_agreement: Existing source-pinned behavioral contracts: exact identities, decision/mask/RNG contracts and documented per-test continuous tolerances/ULP bounds. Same-SHA controls required; no new post-hoc tolerance.
metric_definitions.progress_off_ratio: Matched medians of progress/off host timing for the named test; published bound1.5. No threshold relaxation from a single sample.
metric_definitions.completion: Only returned synchronized cold/warm calls count; killed processes and cleanup exit0 do not.

measurement_protocol.comparison: Same harness, economic inputs/parameters/grids, device/precision/toolchain, allocator/cache, retention and seeds. Separate parent->head, handoff->head, main->head.
measurement_protocol.repetitions: Recommend one fresh cold plus >=3 synchronized warm observations, two fresh same-SHA controls where affordable; disclose lesser evidence.
measurement_protocol.timing: Defer HLO formatting, observer census and output I/O; measure unavoidable guards separately. Keep internal planner work inside public-call timings. Do not subtract observer costs without evidence.
measurement_protocol.isolation: Owned existing3A40 production allocation remains unchanged. New measurements require fresh exact-pin owner requests; use intelsr_short CPU resources and mlgpu_short8h GPU ceiling with watchdog margin.
measurement_protocol.partial_failure: Flush phase, actual selected widths and provenance before expensive dispatch. Distinguish timeout, cancellation, OOM, semantic refusal and harness defect.
measurement_protocol.review_environment: Pro may perform bounded CPU/static checks if compatible dependencies exist. No GPU/Slurm work; no forced compatibility transform. Report unexecuted checks explicitly.

balanced.intended_use: Existing default/explicit execution policy, unchanged economic problem; supported solve and ordinary simulation routes.

numerical.structural_semantics: unchanged; no arbitrary tolerance for ownership/feasibility/branch decisions
numerical.published_values: Existing repository contracts, not blanket cross-device bit identity
numerical.process_replay: Preserve supported eager rounding and parameter binding; validate exact admitted dataflow before executing stages
numerical.rng: Fixed-seed subject/regime/taste-shock identity invariant across tiling, chunks and empty regimes
numerical.oracle: Grid-conditional or independent eager/source behavior for unchanged execution transformations; state which oracle is used.

candidate_set_error.configuration: No economic-grid/candidate-set changes are in scope; if a proposed execution repair changes candidates, it needs an explicit independent oracle before acceptance.

resource.device_budget: Explicit measured per-device ceiling and admitted represented storage, with qualified runtime/allocator limits; not an unconditional physical fit guarantee.
resource.hard_absolute_runtime: No newly invented universal SLA. Existing CI/job/test bounds apply to their exact workload; current warm regression still requires explanation and remediation/explicit tradeoff.

balanced.on_budget_exhaustion: Preserve supported pre-dispatch refusal; propose fresh bounded tuning without classifying it as automatic recovery.
balanced.on_unresolved_certification: State unsupported/unknown claim and smallest exact next gate; deliver the steering plan.

repair_review_triggers.comparison: Same-control parent->head and separately main->head, outside observed noise. These are review triggers, not universal acceptance limits or permission for numerical changes.
